data.name: Usage
data.value: Usage: marquee devices marquee show-image <file> [--orientation portrait|portrait-flipped|landscape|landscape-flipped] [--brightness 0-100] [--repeat N] [--sink <folder>] marquee sensors [--sensors lhm|hwinfo|none] [--no-claude-usage] [--config <file>] marquee run [<theme-folder>] [--orientation ...] [--fps 1-60] [--sensors lhm|hwinfo|none] [--preview] [--sink <folder>] [--frames N] [--http-port 1024-65535 | --no-http] [--no-claude-usage] [--no-fps] [--config <file>] marquee validate <theme-folder|zip> [--fps 1-60] marquee push <key> <value> [--ttl 30s|5m|2h] [--port 1024-65535] [--config <file>] marquee setup-claude [--undo] [--dry-run] marquee statusline (Claude Code runs this; see setup-claude) Settings not given on the command line come from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Marquee\config.yaml, or the file --config names.
data.comment: Printed when the arguments are wrong. Commands, options and paths stay as they are; names such as <file>, the note in parentheses and the last sentence may be translated.

data.name: LogWarning
data.comment: {0} is the warning.

data.name: LogError
data.comment: {0} is the error.

data.name: NoSupportedScreens
data.comment: marquee devices, with no screen plugged in.

data.name: NoScreenFound
data.value: No supported screen found. Run `marquee devices` to check.

data.name: CouldNotReadImage
data.comment: {0} is the image file.

data.name: ImageStretchedToPortrait
data.value: Warning: image is {0}x{1} but the portrait canvas is {2}x{3}; it will be stretched.
data.comment: {0}x{1} is the image's width and height in pixels, {2}x{3} the screen's.

data.name: ImageStretchedToLandscape
data.value: Warning: image is {0}x{1} but the landscape canvas is {2}x{3}; it will be stretched.
data.comment: {0}x{1} is the image's width and height in pixels, {2}x{3} the screen's.

data.name: SentImage
data.comment: {0} is the image file, {1} the screen's name.

data.name: SentImageWithFirmware
data.comment: {0} is the image file, {1} the screen's name, {2} its firmware version.

data.name: PushedFrames
data.value: Pushed {0} frames, average {1:F1} ms per frame
data.comment: {0} is how many frames, {1:F1} the average milliseconds per frame.

data.name: SourceFailed
data.comment: {0} is a sensor source, {1} the reason.

data.name: ConfigFileMissing
data.value: There is no {0}; using the default settings.
data.comment: {0} is the config file --config names, as a full path.

data.name: DataFolderUnusable
data.value: Marquee is running as administrator, so it keeps its log and the Claude Code limits in a folder only administrators can change, and that folder can't be used. {0}
data.comment: Printed when marquee run, elevated, can't use its folder under %ProgramData%\Marquee, and stops. {0} says which folder and why, and what to do, in English.

data.name: SettingsUnchanged
data.value: {0} (the current settings stay until the file is fixed)
data.comment: Logged when config.yaml changes while marquee run is going but can't be used. {0} is the error, starting with its line number where there is one.

data.name: FramesNotDelivered
data.comment: Follows "Error: ". {0} is how many frames arrived, {1} how many were asked for, {2} the screen's name.

data.name: RenderedFrames
data.comment: {0} is how many frames, {1} the screen's name.

data.name: RenderingTo
data.value: Rendering to {0}. Edit the theme and save to reload; press Ctrl+C to stop.
data.comment: {0} is the screen's name.

data.name: RenderStatus
data.value: {0:0.0} fps (target {1}) · render {2:0.0} ms · send {3:0.0} ms · {4} frames sent
data.comment: Shown each second in the preview. {0:0.0} is the frame rate, {1} the target rate, {2:0.0} and {3:0.0} milliseconds per frame to render and to send, {4} the frames sent so far.

data.name: InvalidCustomKey
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid key: use letters, digits, _ and dots after "custom." ({1} characters at most).
data.comment: {0} is the key as typed, {1} the longest a key may be. "custom." is part of every key and stays as it is.

data.name: HttpOffInConfig
data.value: Custom values are turned off in {0} (http: off), so Marquee isn't listening for them. Turn http on there, or pass --port if Marquee was started with --http-port.
data.comment: marquee push without --port. {0} is the path of config.yaml. "http: off" and "http" are what the file says and stay as they are.

data.name: UnknownProgram
data.comment: Fills {0} in RunSetupFromMarquee when Windows doesn't say which program is running.

data.name: RunSetupFromMarquee
data.value: Run setup-claude from marquee.exe itself (this is {0}), so Claude Code gets a command that works on its own.
data.comment: {0} is the program that ran setup-claude, a path or UnknownProgram.

data.name: DryRunWouldWrite
data.value: Dry run: nothing was written. {0} would become:
data.comment: {0} is the path of Claude Code's settings file; its new contents follow on the next lines.

data.name: WithoutDryRun
data.comment: {0} says what setup-claude would change.

data.name: LimitsAppearAfterSetup
data.value: Limits appear once `marquee run` is going and a Claude Code session updates its status line. A project's .claude/settings.json or managed settings with their own statusLine take precedence over this one.

data.name: CouldNotUpdateClaudeSettings
data.value: Could not update Claude Code's settings: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the reason.

data.name: ValidateErrorOnLine
data.comment: marquee validate, one problem. {0} is a file in the theme (layout.yaml, say), {1} the line, {2} the problem (English). Editors and scripts read "file:line:", so keep that part as it is.

data.name: ValidateError
data.comment: marquee validate, a problem not on one line. {0} is a file in the theme, or the theme's path for the theme as a whole; {1} the problem (English).

data.name: ValidateWarningOnLine
data.comment: As ValidateErrorOnLine, for something that works but may not be what the author meant.

data.name: ValidateWarning
data.comment: As ValidateError, for something that works but may not be what the author meant.

data.name: ValidateSummary
data.comment: marquee validate's last line. {0} is the theme's name, {1} its orientation as layout.yaml says it (landscape or portrait, which stay as they are), {2}×{3} its width and height in pixels, {4} NoProblemsFound or the counts.

data.name: ValidateSummaryNoCanvas
data.comment: As ValidateSummary, for a theme whose layout.yaml declares no valid canvas.

data.name: ValidateZipElevated
data.value: Marquee is running as administrator, so it won't check a .zip: it would unpack it into your temp folder, which your other programs can change. Run marquee validate on the .zip from a normal terminal, or unzip it and validate the folder.
data.comment: marquee validate, run as administrator on a .zip, checked nothing. The command name stays as it is.

data.name: NoProblemsFound
data.comment: Fills {4} in ValidateSummary.

data.name: ManyErrors
data.comment: {0} is how many, 2 or more.

data.name: ManyWarnings
data.comment: {0} is how many, 2 or more.

data.name: ErrorsAndWarnings
data.comment: {0} is OneError or ManyErrors, {1} OneWarning or ManyWarnings.
